notes: S4 was supposed to be the decision gate for the S5/S6 fork. Empirical execution revealed that the gate cannot fire on the dev host — the failing-cluster race needs CI-like contention OR a deterministic trigger (planned in S7 via __notestrTestArmAutoInvite). The chicken-and-egg ordering between S6 and S7 surfaces here for the first time.

The diagnostic harness is correctly engineered (S3 verified). The empirical limitation is not a defect in S3 but a consequence of (a) absent CI infrastructure (GAP-3), (b) the no-modify-cluster-tests constraint forcing a representative-scenario reduction, (c) the race only manifesting under contention.

Pre-run friction with Playwright browser revisions (1208 vs 1223) is a META concern worth raising to the user — the project's cross-platform stamping in the Makefile covers node_modules but not /opt/playwright-browsers.
